QuestInfo.name: Starlight Festival Season 5
QuestInfo.0: The bleak fall wind brings a shiver to your bones. Cassandra is putting together Starlight Festival Season 5! If you want to participate, visit Cassandra between #bNovember 25th and December 10th#k.
QuestInfo.1: Starlight Festival Season 5 started with a bleak fall wind! You hear that you will be given one Star Stamp that is usable at the website every 45 minutes if you hold on to the 'Hot Stone' Cassandra gave you...
